source.diagram: CaO-MgO phase diagram after Doman et al. [1] (solid lines); calculated phase equilibria of Hillert, Wang [4] with the higher melting temperature of CaO (dashed lines)
source.caption: Atlas text (printed p. 61): 'The solubility of CaO in MgO between 1100 and 1180 °C has later been re-investigated by Henney, Jones [2]. The mutual solubility at 1500 °C was also investigated by Shirasuka et al. [3]. The thermodynamics of the system and calculated phase equilibria in which the higher melting temperature of CaO is accepted have been reported by Hillert, Wang [4]. Their results are shown in the figure with dashed lines. For recent thermodynamic assessment and discussion of the system, see Jin, Du [5] Howald [6] and Wu at al. [7]' References: [1] R. C. Doman, J. B. Barr, R. N. McNally, A. M. Alper, J. Am. Ceram. Soc. 46 (1963) No. 7, p. 313/6; [2] J. W. Henney, J. W. S. Jones, Trans. J. Br. Ceram. Soc. 68 (1969), p. 201/3; [3] K. Shirasuka, G. Yamaguchi, M. Sekiya, Sekko To Sekkai (1975) No. 139, p. 223/6; [4] M. Hillert, X. Wang, CALPHAD 13 (1989) No. 3, p. 267/72; [5] Z. Jin, Y. Du, CALPHAD 16 (1992) No. 1, p. 33/36; [6] R. A. Howald, CALPHAD 16 (1992) No. 1, p. 25/32; [7] P. Wu, G. Eriksson, A. D. Pelton, J. Am. Ceram. Soc. 76 (1993) No. 8, p. 2065/75.
